command: ls -la reporting/ && grep -n -E "^kind:|tier:|namespace:" reporting/* ; kubectl apply --prune -l tier=batch -n reporting-1045 -f reporting/ --dry-run=server

kubectl get deploy,svc -n reporting-1045 -l tier=batch -L tier,app --show-labels; kubectl get deploy audit-trail legacy-export -n reporting-1045 -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{" "}{.metadata.annotations}{" replicas="}{.status.readyReplicas}{"\n"}{end}'
kubectl apply -n reporting-1045 -f reporting/ && kubectl delete deploy legacy-export -n reporting-1045 && kubectl get deploy,svc -n reporting-1045
